text.content: play a card of the same suit or rank as the top of the pile;
eights go on anything and name the next suit. first out wins
a d or the arrows pick a card, w s to the stock, spacebar plays or draws;
after an eight, spacebar on a card names its suit. or click with the mouse
your turn: play a card that matches, or draw
name a suit: pick a card of it in your hand
